editorial.blurb: Tang Korean Restaurant delivers authentic, beautifully executed Korean cuisine in a warm, hospitable setting where the staff's genuine care for each guest shines as brightly as the flavorful broths and tender meats.
editorial.insiderTip: Go at lunchtime when it's quieter, and don't miss the complimentary hot tea and extra kimchi they'll bring to your table—the portions are generous enough for 2-3 people, so order strategically.
